snippet.title: FE: Bound Destiny - Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Get Bound Destiny here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RTP6EF6UDnRLI9E7LlGGYXRwiq7XKY3v/view?usp=drive_link

Watch a full playthrough here: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLrIPZz2h4r5FSIN7GTfNsimy4WtSB1uO6&feature=shared

Join the Discord server to stay up-to-date on this and other projects featured on this channel: https://discord.com/invite/VVsSxuwYF2

This trailer was made for #MysteryDungeon day on Twitter. This is the original, 3-minute cut of the trailer.
